description: This file defines the DeviceRegistration entity class for the Fineract project, representing a device registration record associated with a client. It maps to the 'client_device_registration' database table, managing device registration details such as registration ID and update timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceRegistration
classes.description: Entity class representing a device registration record linked to a client, stored in the 'client_device_registration' table with fields for client, registration ID, and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DeviceRegistration object with the specified client and registration ID, initializing the update timestamp to the current local date time.
